description: Bicycle Infrastructure Network is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. This dataset shows the cycling infrastructure across Metropolitan Melbourne, Geelong, Ballarat and Bendigo. The dataset was extracted and modified using data from OpenStreetMap (OSM) and simplified into high-level categories of cycling infrastructure as outlined in the supporting documentation. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are bicycle, bike, cycling. It offers 3 resource(s) in GEOJSON, PARQUET, PDF. The portal shows 2025-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is unknown. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
